Synopsis:
Players meet Daisy in person for the first time. Daisy will invite the player to kill them, knowing that Vlaakith has ordered the player to do so. The player will be able to ask Daisy about the astral prison, the Absolute, and why the gith are after them,

Cluster Contexts:
- CRE_AstralPrison_Daisy.json: The player meets Daisy in the Astral Plane for the first time; she’s awake, kneels and offers a sword, openly inviting the player to kill her because Vlaakith has ordered it. Off-screen Vlaakith and the githyanki leadership are actively hunting Daisy — Daisy claims she stole an artifact from Vlaakith, knows a secret that would end Vlaakith’s rule, and says she’s been protecting the player from the Absolute. The player has been primed by Vlaakith to believe Daisy is an agent of the illithid Grand Design, so trust is the central tension. Nearby gith like Laezel are tied to Vlaakith and recent events (the Zaithisk detonation referenced in cluster contexts) have already unsettled or complicated gith loyalties.
- CRE_AstralPrison_Daisy_OM_Laezel_AOM.json: Avatar Lae'zel meets Daisy in person for the first time. Daisy will invite the player to kill them, knowing that Vlaakith has ordered the player to do so. The player will be able to ask Daisy about the astral prison, the Absolute, and why the gith are after them,
- CRE_AstralPrison_DaisyCaveEntrance.json: The player has a dialog with a disembodied voice of Daisy at the entrance to a cave in the Astral Prism. She is only willing to talk to one player Avatar. No companions.Will add group decision for the leader avatar when it's available.
- GLO_GatherYourAllies_DaisyJournalBegin.json: Daisy sets you on the mission to gather allies upon trying to leave SCE. Entire dialogue is telepathic (Daisy does not show up in the world.)
- CRE_ChainOfCommand_Vlaakith_OM_Laezel_COM.json: Vlaaktih appears as a hologram and Laezel meets her for the first time. Avatar can decide if she accepts her orders to kill the prisoner or refuse. In both cases, the planecaster is activated.If you refuse, Vlaakith orders the inquisitor if alive to kill you if you try to exit the room or theatens to hunt you down if he's already dead. If Laezel is not yet convinced to side with the player, they have a chance to do it here if they refuse.

context: You encounter Daisy in person for the first time inside the Astral Plane prison: she’s fully awake, kneels and offers you a sword, openly inviting you to kill her because Vlaakith has ordered it. Off-screen Vlaakith and gith leadership are actively hunting Daisy; Daisy claims she stole an artifact from Vlaakith and knows a secret that could end Vlaakith’s rule. She also says that same secret is how she’s been protecting you from the Absolute and insists she’s been on your side, even as Vlaakith primed you to see her as an agent of the illithid Grand Design. Nearby gith (for example Lae’zel) remain tied to Vlaakith and recent events (like the Zaithisk detonation) have unsettled loyalties—trust is the central tension, and you can ask Daisy about the astral prison, the Absolute, and why the gith hunt her.
